title: avena coarctata
intro: Avena coarctata, commonly known as the oat grass or oat straw, is a type of plant belonging to the Avena genus. The oat grass is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues, promote relaxation, and reduce stress. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its calming effects on the nervous system, which can help alleviate anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Avena coarctata include avenanthramides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
